decision_conditions: I<span id="docs-internal-guid-2063487e-7fff-5f61-bb7c-8aff6015c8f8"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">n the absence of a Unilateral Undertaking or a Section 106 Agreement to secure appropriate rent levels in accordance with the Local Housing Allowance, the development would fail to secure the proposed House in Multiple Occupation at an affordable rent level, contrary to policy LP22 (Houses in Multiple Occupation) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></span>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-90308d65-7fff-ed79-f9b7-913b6ab16906"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of intensifying the use of the property, would result in increased levels of noise and general disturbance. In the absence of a clear Management Plan, it has not been demonstrated that such impacts could be adequately controlled or mitigated. The proposal would therefore result in harm to the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers, contrary to policies D14 (Noise) of the London Plan and LP2 (Development and Amenity), LP22 (Houses in Multiple Accomodation) and LP58 (Improving the Environment - Pollution) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-74cfe587-7fff-7fe4-ae6a-a2e541e535d6"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of its form, scale and unclear architectural detailing, is unacceptable in terms of design terms and would have an adverse impact on the character and appearance of the application site and adjoining properties. The development does not comply with Policy LP1 of Hackney Local Plan 2033, Policy D3 (Optimising Site Capacity through the Design-led Approach), as well as the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-49ca8d91-7fff-2304-bf20-c84c46a66050"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of the inadequate provision of cycle parking, fails to demonstrate that parking would be safe, secure and conveniently accessible for all users. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policy LP42 (Walking and Cycling)&nbsp; of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the Hackney Transport Strategy 2015-2025.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a0a326f9-7fff-9fc8-8cfc-3248903eb3e5"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of insufficient details with regard to refuse and recycling, would fail to alleviate the Council’s concern the proposal would have sufficient waste provision on site, to the detriment of living conditions and pollution in the site area. The proposal fails to meet the requirements set out in policies LP57 (Waste) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and policy SI 7 (Reducing waste and supporting the circular economy) of the London Plan (2021).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b9a036a9-7fff-3d0c-94fc-bb9535d44c56"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">In the absence of a Unilateral Undertaking or a Section 106 Agreement securing appropriate mitigation by restricting future occupiers of the development from obtaining parking permits within the Controlled Parking Zone, the proposed development would likely exacerbate existing parking stress and congestion on the surrounding highway network. The development would, therefore, be contrary to policies LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP45 (Parking and Car-Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and policies T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) and T6 (Car parking) of the London Plan (2021).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-5ffab218-7fff-b096-9828-af7a471efc08"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of insufficiently sized communal kitchen facilities relative to the number of intended occupiers and the failure to demonstrate adequate internal headroom within the accommodation, has failed to demonstrate that it would provide a high-quality and acceptable standard of residential accommodation. The proposal would therefore result in a substandard form of development, harmful to the living conditions of future occupiers, and would be contrary to Policies LP2 (Development and Amenity), LP17 (Housing Design) and LP22 (Houses in Multiple Occupation) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b6f97397-7fff-3fb6-9d71-fa1cd282dd96"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of the absence of sufficient information regarding the proposed management arrangements and the length of tenancy agreements, has failed to demonstrate that the standard of housing accommodation would be acceptable in terms of potential amenity impacts to residents of the site and surrounding area, and would provide a secure form of accommodation for prospective future tenants, to the detriment of meeting the borough’s housing needs. The proposal is contrary to policies LP2 (Development and Amenity) and LP22 (Houses in Multiple Occupation) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</span></span></p>
description: Conversion of existing semi-detached dwelling into a large House in Multiple Occupation (HMO) (Sui Generis) for 8 persons in 8 rooms, with associated part single side and rear extensions, loft extension rear dormers and provision of refuse storage, secure cycle parking, and private amenity space.
